poll.source_locator: Marginals Q7 (N=500): Sherrod Brown 233 (46.60), Jon Husted 219 (43.80), Greg Levy (Other-Party) 8 (1.60), William B. Redpath (L) 8 (1.60), Write-in 0, Undecided 22 (4.40), Refused 10 (2.00)
poll.notes: Question asks 'plan to vote for or lean toward', so LEANERS. other = Levy 1.6 + Redpath 1.6; Refused 2.0 not folded in. Field dates and LV definition from the press release (https://www.suffolk.edu/-/media/suffolk/documents/academics/research-at-suffolk/suprc/polls/other-states/2026/10_28_2026_ohio_press_release.pdf), which rounds to 47-44, other 3, undecided 4. 270toWin mislabels this poll 'Siena College'.
